visual_practice.selection: LR ranks erroneous eligible vocabulary by predicted text correctness
visual_practice.outcomes: Separate visual records; queued native text/listen follow-up updates both model histories

domain: Beginner English vocabulary and simple sentences with Turkish instructions

dev_feature_experiments.status: Three fixed feature-group candidates fitted on TRAIN and compared on DEV; original production model preserved
dev_feature_experiments.interpretation: DEV evidence favors both groups, with most gain from format history and a smaller incremental recent-history gain. Exploratory, not final or new-student validation; unseen-word ranking remains additive.

dev_baseline_comparison.status: Completed on 23583 DEV targets from the same 200 learners; original frozen model preserved
dev_baseline_comparison.interpretation: DEV evidence of contribution over these fixed simple rules; modest threshold accuracy gain, low error recall; not validation on new learners or custom app exercises

modalities.text: Short answer for one expected English word
modalities.audio: Prepared English recording and typed target word
modalities.visual: Topic preference selection; not computer vision

practice_round.review_order: Lower predicted correctness first within eligible topic pool
practice_round.cooldown: Two other questions before repeating a word
practice_round.second_error: Explain and defer to the next session
practice_round.missing_pool: Use the other eligible pool and disclose the reason
practice_round.visual_followup_priority: Within eligible review pool; preserve cooldown/max-count/second-error constraints; rank queued candidates by LR

supervised.history_scope: Only prior completed reverse_translate and listen interactions

unsupervised.profile_window: Last 6 completed exercises per format; provisional profile
unsupervised.source_target_rule: First alphabetic noun or proper noun, otherwise first alphabetic token; no use of correctness in target selection
unsupervised.selection: Highest silhouette among valid candidates; smaller k on exact tie; do not force a result
unsupervised.labels: Observed performance patterns; not learning styles or CEFR levels

next_scope: Real-student delayed retention and teaching-effect validation; source-to-local calibration remains unverified

pilot.lr: Unassisted text and listening-writing predictions; writing-remediation ordering
pilot.kmeans: Last 6 text + 6 actual listening-writing; source reference group when available; no question selection effect

support_policy.second_error: pause only this target across cycles

support_policy.target_evidence_versioning: per word+skill; only retaught targets reset; other evidence/deadlines retained
